en: The black and white image depicts a river port scene with several docked boats, people working at the quay, and carts transporting barrels and other goods. In the background, there is a small town with distinctive European architecture, set against a dramatic rocky hill. On top of the hill, a small building, possibly a chapel or lookout, is visible. The landscape is lush and hilly, typical of Central Europe, with a railway or tram line running along the waterfront.
